Hi Sree,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great conversation and good signal that Quantiv has clear ROI use cases for model-powered summarization and reranking. Per next steps we put together an executive demo + technical deep-dive. I attached the RFP you sent and a short Redwood deck so folks can pre-read.

Heads up: Monica and I are flexible on format (30m exec primer + 60–90m tech) but wanted to confirm attendee list before locking times — you mentioned procurement and the CFO might join.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Tue Aug 11: 11:00–12:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu Aug 13: 10:30–12:00 or 14:00–15:30

If you have a preferred day/time and an internal attendee list, we’ll send an invite and a short mutual action plan (attached). If the timing is impacted by internal budget/approval cycles let me know — happy to split the program into a short exec primer while finance completes the reforecast, then schedule the technical session once the spend window is clear.

Attachments: Quantiv_RFP_Q3.pdf, redwood-demo-deck.pdf

Best,

Laura —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the materials. Quick update from our side: the finance team has put a temporary hold on new vendor evaluations tied to Q3 spend until the CFO returns from travel and we complete a fast reforecast. That likely pushes any procurement decisioning out of the week of Aug 10–14. The earliest realistic window for a full procurement/technical deep-dive is the week of Aug 24.

That said, we do want to keep momentum. Two requests from us:
1) Can we do a short 20–30 minute executive primer focused on the business case (no pricing/contract discussion) while the CFO is still able to attend? He is back Aug 14 but travel dates are tight — Aug 13 morning ET might work.
2) Please hold a placeholder week starting Aug 24 for a technical deep-dive with procurement/engineering (we’ll confirm exact date once reforecast closes).

We’ll loop in procurement formally once we have an internal date. For now, can you tentatively hold Aug 13 11:00 ET and the week of Aug 24 for the longer session?

Thanks,
Sree
Director, Product Strategy
Quantiv Analytics

Sree —

Thanks for the transparency, that makes total sense. We’re happy to accommodate a two-step cadence to keep momentum without forcing procurement/contracting into the reforecast window. Suggested plan:

1) Executive primer (30 minutes) — high-level outcomes, customer examples, minimal slides, no pricing: Aug 13 11:00 ET (we’ll keep it tight so CFO can join)
2) Technical deep-dive (60–90 minutes) — architecture, performance profiles, mutual action plan review: week of Aug 24 (placeholder: Tue Aug 25 or Wed Aug 26)

I attached a short mutual_action_plan.xlsx with suggested owners and a tentative timeline that aligns with your reforecast cadence. We’ll also provide an updated, no-obligation cost estimate geared to the pilot (covers dedicated throughput vs hosted) so procurement has something to review once the spend window reopens.

If Aug 13 11:00 ET works, I’ll send an invite to the attendees you confirm and include a tiny prep doc (10 bullets) so the CFO can scan in <5 minutes.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx
